meta.query: How has the number of trials for this drug changed per year since 2015?

plan.rationale: The user asks how the number of trials for tirzepatide has changed per year since 2015.

counting_rules: Drug filter: ClinicalTrials.gov search results were kept only if an intervention name, a registered synonym of it, or the brief title names the drug (placebo arms don't count). The matching field is included in each citation; dropped trials are listed in meta.cohorts[].excluded_nct_ids.
Trials are bucketed by registered start date, which for future trials is an estimate.
warnings: 2026 is incomplete, and later years only contain trials with an estimated (planned) start date.
